places.name: Clara's ranch
places.note: Lorena settles into home life there; Bob dies in the night and is buried on the ridge above the barn beside his three sons, with German neighbors and a tipsy preacher attending.
places.location_hint: Allen horse ranch on the North Platte in Nebraska; a river runs by it, a ridge above the barn holds family graves, nearest neighbors are a few German farm families, a town is within a wagon trip

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Lorena recalls her room there, where letting men in was the price of having it.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: July sometimes longs for his old lawman job there, though Roscoe is gone.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: July knows he cannot realistically take baby Martin back there to raise him.

places.name: New York City
places.note: Clara muses that in so crowded a place deaths would go less noticed.
